title: Vow and Postcard
author: Freya Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Halloran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
